_comment: Domain-level pi settings. Apply to all projects in this domain. Project .pi/settings.json can override any key. Deployed to ~/.pi/domain/<domain-name>/.pi/settings.json by install.sh.
_comment_model: Model selection. Domain-level default. Override per project.
_comment_thinking: defaultThinkingLevel must be a string: 'none' | 'low' | 'medium' | 'high'. Not an object.
_comment_skills: Domain-level skills. install.sh replaces <domain-name> placeholder with actual domain name.
_comment_extensions: Domain-level extensions. memory-db.ts is the domain memory extension.
_comment_env: Env file for domain extensions. Contains PI_DOMAIN_NAME and other memory-db vars.
_comment_compaction: Context compaction config. Keeps last 6K tokens of recent context when compacting.
_comment_retry: Retry config for failed tool calls.
